description:
Configure Copper POS to calculate taxes as 'Inclusive' (VAT style) and verify the setup with a test sale.

Goal: Change the tax setting so item prices include tax, set the tax rate to 20%, and process a sale for 'Premium Wool Scarf' (Price: 120.00) to confirm the tax is calculated backwards (20.00 tax included) rather than added on top.

Starting State: Copper POS is open. Item 'Premium Wool Scarf' exists @ 120.00. Default tax settings are active (Tax Exclusive).

Expected Actions:
1. Go to Options > Tax.
2. Create/Set a tax rate of 20% (name it 'VAT').
3. Enable the checkbox 'Item prices are tax inclusive'.
4. Save settings.
5. Process a sale for 1x 'Premium Wool Scarf'.
6. Verify Total is 120.00 and Tax is 20.00.
7. Finalize the sale (Cash).
8. Save a screenshot of the receipt/transaction success screen to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\vat_test_receipt.png'.
